description: Researchers choose examples, propose grammar and vocabulary, and test their claims against withheld evidence. This is a new deterministic seeded instance of the existing alien-language environment, with its own starting world and a 12-decision campaign. Campaign completion records the end of observation, without claiming the goal was achieved. Goal: Within a 12-decision campaign, infer the seeded vocabulary, word order and past marker from chosen observations; submit a complete grammar and measure it against all nine withheld sentences without claiming untested accuracy.
